_doc: G5 consecutive-failure auto-rollback ledger. current_streak increments ONLY on new agent-written-code bugs; infrastructure failures (HF timeout, scp race, node OOM, walltime-kill of working code) set counted_in_streak=false and do NOT increment. At current_streak >= max_streak, set auto_rollback_triggered=true and downgrade all T1 auto-submits to human-approval until a HUMAN resets (the agent must not clear its own rollback). A clean new-code success resets current_streak to 0.
